title_zh: 中山门与东城墙 1937-12-10 至 12-13（战斗时间表）
title_en: Zhongshan Gate and the east wall, 10-13 December 1937 (control timetable)

clock.label: 推测
clock.src: CONTRACT2 R2; OOB.md 0 TIME ZONE RULE (jp-090: Japanese hours carry no stated zone; JST would be one hour ahead of Nanjing). The gate is taken at the printed 03:10 (ja.wikipedia); the timeline's replaced event ev-1213-33rd-zsm already uses local 02:20-03:30 (JST minus 1 h). One number (shift_s) changes it later.

in.note: replaced: the staff group is in the bake from 10:00 at the sentry line
replaced: the Japanese on the east bank are the bake's

replaced: the 33rd (2nd and 3rd Battalions and HQ, 1,448 men) is the bake's from its entry at 12 Dec 22:30; they come from bs-1208-zijinshan, which hands them out at 21:00 (hands.out there); the 1st Battalion and the gun company stay on the mountain

out.note: the main body enters from 13 Dec 06:30; the bake keeps its last holds on and around the gate until that event's figures stand there (FIX3 item 2); ev-1213-zsm-rush (07:28) is outside the span and stays as it is

external_fire.label: 推测
external_fire.src: jp-030, F22: the 16th Division guns on the second peak shell 中山门 until the wall gives way (about 15:00, wall.json); drawn in bs-1208-zijinshan (wave H reconcile); this bake owns the wall and the men near it; the guns lift from the breach at 15:00 (C7: the 20th Regt companies stand 60-100 m from it); the original event's 8 guns are read as these 4 plus the 20th Regt's 4 direct-fire guns (jp-20-rg here); the Type 38 field guns (8) and Type 91 howitzers (4) this file had are removed: no source places them (MACHINES.md 3: no gun count at 中山门)

marks.text_zh: 10 日上午：日军参谋在门外东约500米的哨线等候守军使者（人数、地点为推测）
marks.text_en: 10 Dec morning: Japanese staff officers wait at the sentry line about 500 m east of the gate for the Chinese envoy (number and place 推测)
marks.label: 推测

marks.text_zh: 10 日正午：劝降期限到，无人来，城门关着
marks.text_en: Noon, 10 Dec: the ultimatum expires; nobody comes; the gate stays shut
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: ne.jp Ncp34 (noon is the deadline), en.wikipedia (staff officers waited to see if the gate would be opened); the reply place differs between the sources (battle_zhongshan.md, Disputes 3)

marks.text_zh: 13:00 松井下令全面进攻（一说 11:00，单一来源）
marks.text_en: 13:00 Matsui orders the general attack (one Chinese source says 11:00)
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: en.wikipedia and ja.wikipedia (via battle_zhongshan.md, FACT_DIGEST line 100)

marks.text_zh: 11 日：门前护城河东岸对峙，没有这一段的专项记载
marks.text_en: 11 Dec: a stand-off on the east bank; no source describes this gate on this day
marks.label: 推测
marks.src: battle_zhongshan.md: 11 Dec at the gate is an extension of the same chain (推测)

marks.text_zh: 12 日上午：紫金山上的炮（由紫金山场景绘出）开始轰击中山门（钟点取时间线，推测）
marks.text_en: 12 Dec morning: the guns on Purple Mountain (drawn in bs-1208-zijinshan) begin to shell Zhongshan Gate (hour from the timeline, 推测)
marks.label: 推测

marks.text_zh: 12 日：城墙在门以南塌下一大段（钟点与位置取 wall.json，推测）
marks.text_en: 12 Dec: a large part of the wall south of the gate gives way under the guns (hour and place from wall.json, 推测)
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: jp-030, F22 (en.wikipedia: a large portion of the wall suddenly gave way; no hour); wall.json breaches zhongshan-s 15:00 (推测)

marks.text_zh: 17:30 守军开始撤出（唐生智17:00下令）
marks.text_en: 17:30 the defenders begin to leave (the 17:00 order at Tang's)
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: F28; jp-028 (Ncp34: the Chinese began to leave on the night of 12 Dec)

marks.text_zh: 13 日凌晨：第33联队摸黑沿墙脚接近中山门；门顶还有小股守军开火（推测）
marks.text_en: 13 Dec, small hours: the 33rd comes along the wall foot in the dark; a rear guard on the gate top still fires (推测)
marks.label: 推测
marks.src: ja.wikipedia (03:10); jp-028 (the gate 'empty or nearly so'); the rear guard is 推测

marks.text_zh: 03:10（日本记载钟点）第33联队占领中山门；该联队中队长全部战死（日文维基）
marks.text_en: 03:10 (as printed) the 33rd Regiment occupies Zhongshan Gate; its company commanders are all killed (ja.wikipedia)
marks.label: 核实
marks.src: ja.wikipedia 南京攻略戦 (read back 2026-11-21 by this author: 午前3時10分 ... 歩兵33聯隊は中山門を占領 / 同隊中隊長は全員戦死した); jp-028 (the checker could not read the second sentence back); the hour may be Tokyo time

marks.text_zh: 05:00 门洞沙袋清除（钟点取 wall.json，推测）

marks.src: wall.json gates zhongshan seal end 13 Dec 05:00
